CustomField.description: If the Account is tied to an IMGA, it will return that IMGA's Seb-Segment, otherwise it will return the Sub-Segment listed on the Account. #28092: If IMGA Account has Global Industries enabled, fetches IMGA's Account Sub-Segment else fetches Country Parent's Account Sub- Segment
CustomField.formula:
/* The values in Sub-Segment are copied down to the all Child Accounts (Country Parent,Sales Site) when IMGA Account has 'Global Industries' checkbox marked True else data is copied from Country Parent to Sales Site,*/
IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Sales (Site)'), ISPICKVAL(Parent.Parent.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'IM Group (IMGA)'), Parent.Parent.Global_Account__c ), TEXT(Parent.Parent.Account_Sub_Segment__c), IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Sales (Site)'), ISPICKVAL(Parent.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Country Parent') ),TEXT(Parent.Account_Sub_Segment__c), IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Country Parent'), ISPICKVAL(Parent.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'IM Group (IMGA)'), Parent.Global_Account__c ),TEXT(Parent.Account_Sub_Segment__c),TEXT(Account_Sub_Segment__c))))
CustomField.label: Account Sub-Segment
